title: E1-ter: calibrated two-sided test of the learned distinguisher D4 on fresh ALASKA2 covers
registered: 2026-11-24, after review (finding F01 of the 24 Nov 2026 regression audit); fixed before any E1-ter image is downloaded or processed
does_not_change: the registered outcomes of E1 (G3 failed for D4 on BOSSbase/BOWS2) and of E1-bis (G3' passed); E1-ter is reported as a separate, later replication
ids_rule: every index of ALASKAv2Base_by_DSC.txt outside the *_FLATS and *_TEXTURES groups and outside e1bis_ids.txt (which contains the E7 list); no sampling
cells: layout A8, Kemeleon variants 1536 B and 1252 B, buckets 256-8192 (12 cells), syndrome extraction identical to E1-bis
statistic: D4 of E1 unchanged: seq_features, standardization on the training part, logistic regression C = 0.05, 5-fold cross-validation; signed advantage adv = 2 acc - 1 over all images
null: R = 1000 data sets per syndrome length, uniform strings for both classes, n images, random folds, five models retrained per data set (scripts/confirm/e1bis_power.py one(), seed tag 40); computed before extraction
rule_equivalence: a cell passes when |adv| + 1.645 SD_null(L) <= 0.02 (two one-sided tests at 0.05); the claim 'all twelve cells within 0.02' is an intersection-union test at level 0.05
rule_detection: two-sided null p-value (1 + #{|adv_null| >= |adv|}) / (R + 1); Holm over the twelve cells at 0.05
verdict: 'equivalent within 0.02' if all twelve cells pass; 'distinguisher detected' if a Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05; otherwise 'inconclusive'
operating_characteristics: type-I error of each cell's equivalence claim at |adv| = 0.02 is 0.05 under the normal approximation with the s.d. at the margin equal to SD_null; power at adv = 0 is computed in the design step from the null draws and reported before extraction
D1: LLR difference with bootstrap CI, descriptive only
deviations: any change after this file is committed is listed with its date in the supplementary material
